scripts.lint:db: supabase db lint --local --schema public --level warning --fail-on warning
scripts.types:db: npx supabase gen types typescript --local | npx prettier --parser typescript > mobile/src/types/database.ts
scripts.check:types: npm run types:db && git diff --exit-code -- mobile/src/types/database.ts
scripts.check:edge: cd supabase/functions && deno fmt --check . && deno lint . && deno check --frozen create-achievement/index.ts delete-account/index.ts process-achievement-jobs/index.ts process-push-deliveries/index.ts process-push-receipts/index.ts retry-achievement/index.ts && deno test --frozen --allow-env _shared/generation_test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown mobile/src mobile/scripts mobile/app.config.ts mobile/eas.json mobile/eslint.config.js mobile/jest.config.js mobile/jest.setup.js mobile/README.md mobile/package.json mobile/tsconfig.json scripts supabase/config.toml supabase/migrations supabase/tests .github README.md ARCHITECTURE.md SECURITY.md RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md DEPENDENCY_RISK.md .env.example .gitignore package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown mobile/src mobile/scripts mobile/app.config.ts mobile/eas.json mobile/eslint.config.js mobile/jest.config.js mobile/jest.setup.js mobile/README.md mobile/package.json mobile/tsconfig.json scripts supabase/config.toml supabase/migrations supabase/tests .github README.md ARCHITECTURE.md SECURITY.md RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md DEPENDENCY_RISK.md .env.example .gitignore package.json
scripts.mobile:start:local: node scripts/with-local-supabase.mjs --serve-functions npm --prefix mobile run start --
scripts.mobile:ios:local: node scripts/with-local-supabase.mjs --serve-functions npm --prefix mobile run ios --
scripts.mobile:android:local: LOCAL_MOBILE_HOST=10.0.2.2 node scripts/with-local-supabase.mjs --serve-functions npm --prefix mobile run android --
scripts.mobile:check: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint
